challenges.title: Dangling OTP in session on sendOTPEmail failure in sendOtp
challenges.desc: In sendOtp, req.session.otpData is populated prior to await emailService.sendOTPEmail. If sending fails, HTTP 500 is returned, but session retains otpData until overwritten or expired. However, without receiving the email, an attacker cannot guess the 6-digit code before 5 max attempts expire.
challenges.blastRadius: Session memory stores an unmailed OTP code; low blast radius due to 5-attempt limit and 5-minute expiry.
challenges.mitigation: Consider clearing req.session.otpData in catch block of sendOtp if emailService.sendOTPEmail fails.
